extracted.name: Crunchy Romaine Salad
extracted.description: A wonderful combination of flavors in this very easy to prepare salad. A ton of crunch comes from ramen noodles, pecans, and romaine lettuce.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper, to taste
1 head romaine lettuce, torn into bite-size pieces
instruction_lines: Add sugar, oil, vinegar, soy sauce, salt, and black pepper to a jar with a tight-fitting lid; shake until well blended. Set aside.
Break ramen noodles into small pieces; set aside. Discard flavor packet.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add pecans and noodles; cook and stir until browned, about 5 minutes. Drain on paper towels; let cool.
Toss broccoli, romaine lettuce, green onions, pecans, and noodles together in a bowl. Add 1 cup, or more, dressing; toss to coat.
